name: Vasaniwebinfotech Convert Image Extension to WebP
author: vasanikevin2016

sections.description:
Vasaniwebinfotech Convert Image Extension to WebP is a powerful and lightweight optimization plugin designed by Vasani Web Infotech to improve website speed and SEO rankings effortlessly.

Key Features

  • Automatic WebP Conversion: Converts all existing and new JPG, JPEG, and PNG images into high-quality WebP format.
  • Smart Size Reduction: Compresses oversized images to the target 100KB–115KB range without losing visual quality.
  • Content URL Mapping: Automatically updates image URLs inside your WordPress posts and pages to prevent broken links or missing images (404 errors).
  • SEO Prefix & Alt Text Generator: Easily bulk-update image titles and alternative texts using custom SEO keywords/prefixes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools > WebP & SEO Optimizer in your WordPress admin menu to start conversion.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Improved bulk conversion speed and fixed extension detection for JPG, JPEG, and PNG images.
  • Optimized batch processing to avoid server timeouts.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with WebP conversion, size enforcement, URL replacement, and SEO naming features.

short_description: Automatically converts JPG and PNG images to WebP format, optimizes size to 100KB-115KB range, updates database URLs, and generates SEO alt text.
